caption: The drag-width check this PR optimizes, exercised end to end: two Infantry regiments are box-selected, then a right-drag deploys them along the dragged line. SelectionManager._can_form_up gates that deploy by comparing the drag's length against FORM_UP_MIN_WIDTH + MULTI_FORM_UP_GAP -- one of the three distance_to comparisons this PR converts to squared distance (Replay.record_pointer, which dedups the recorded pointer track driving this clip, is another). Behavior is identical; the saving is the dropped sqrt per evaluation.
